description: The All-in-One Kiki's Delivery Service Utensil Set!

Whether you pack your lunch at home or you pick up takeout from your favorite restaurant, utensils are a must-have with every meal. And while disposable cutlery gets the job done, that daily waste can have a big impact on the environment.

Practical, portable and undeniably fun, Skater’s Studio Ghibli Utensil Set was designed for anyone who eats on-the-go! Every order includes a spoon (0.71”), pair of chopsticks (0.71”) and durable carrying case (7.4 x 1.85 x 0.71”). Compact and lightweight, the case fits in any backpack or lunch bag and prevents the utensils from dirtying before use.

Officially licensed by Studio Ghibli, Kiki’s Delivery Service Utensil Set "Bakery”. Cute Lunch Carrier with Secure 4-Point Locking Lid. Whether you are a chopstick novice or you have used them for years, our anti-slip design provides complete control over the utensils.

We care about your health as much as you do! That’s why our utensils are made with a food-safe plastic. Durable and long-lasting, you can use them every day without worry. And because they’re safe in the dishwasher, cleanup is quick and easy.
